author: M4x1nator
body:
A long time ago, I remember MC zone. Probably my most favorite server of all time. Always had about 1000 players on, great, fun, games... then it all went away. Survival Games was turned into some Elimination no one played. Ghost squadron went away. Sky wars is still non-exsitant. Nexus was gone too, but came back after far too much time.
What.
Happened.

The server was changed into "Avicus" with a huge unecessary lobby, removed gamemodes, replaced with ones no one played. Did the server management change? Did they decide to revamp the server?

Bring back the MC zone times with all the games it had, but with the technology and staff improved upon it. Nowadays, I see about 200 people on, deserted games, everyone playing Nebula because that's the only one that's for the most part stayed the same, and the best game.

I believe server population and server popularity is completely due to this Avicus update that happened a while ago. I know when it happened, I, quit, along with many others. What's stopping from bringing those times back?

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body: yeah but its kinda true, mczone was better and we were probably still getting better numbers of players than we are now at the end. ppl left when it became avicus. not saying things should all stay the same, but maybe the wrong things changed and we need to face that rather than goin "ah la dee da everything is perfect now! we're not losing players every week!" because the ppl who are hardcore involved in the community and still play are the ones that will stay, but everyone else will fade away. and the winter update will cause more ppl comin on, but only for a while until ppl get bored with it and leave again. this is pretty much what is happening with minecraft itself: you can't keep the way things were a couple years ago, but you also can't get rid of that nostalgia players feel when they think about the game and where they were at in, say, 2010/2011. the developers can't come up with enough updates or just the right features to please everyone, some people will always talk shit and ya just gotta accept that. some ppl will want things to be the way it was, and i feel that because there were player counts in the triple digits a year ago whereas now avicus is lucky to get a few hundred ppl on. its just not keeping up with what the majority of ppl who are involved in avicus, the everyday average players, want. can't keep up. it's just how things go. u guys r talkin bout accepting change well maybe we should all learn to accept changes that are bad too. just my onion
